completeDraftSets.camera: Fixed near side three-quarter facing left, full athlete and wheel with room ahead.
completeDraftSets.equipment: One compact dual-tread ab wheel and thin dark kneeling pad.
reviewFindings: Three distinct poses show a kneeling setup, forward rollout and extended range, then reverse. Both hands remain at the wheel and knees remain on the pad.

Read-only patch matching measures near-knee shifts up to 3px horizontally / 2px vertically, and a pad-corner shift of 2px vertically. These exceed the existing 1px fixed-anchor release limit. Wheel dimensions also need consistency review. Remains a draft.

frames.caption: SET YOUR BRACE 1/6
frames.cue: Kneel; grip the wheel under your shoulders.

frames.caption: ROLL FORWARD 2/6
frames.cue: Roll forward slowly with your core braced.

frames.caption: CONTROL YOUR REACH 3/6
frames.cue: Stop before your lower back starts arching.

frames.caption: KEEP YOUR BRACE 4/6
frames.cue: Keep ribs down and hips extended.

frames.caption: PULL BACK SMOOTHLY 5/6
frames.cue: Use your abs to draw the wheel back.

frames.caption: RESET UNDER SHOULDERS 6/6
frames.cue: Return with control; keep your brace.

completeDraftSets.camera: Fixed near side three-quarter facing left, full athlete and bell with headroom.
reviewFindings: Corrected backswing replaces the rejected shallow hinge; three poses show hinge, ascent and chest-height float.

Read-only patch matching measures both far-shoe contacts 7px upward in the top pose; near shoe moves 1px. This exceeds the existing 1px fixed-anchor release limit. Handle/grip readability and dynamic hip-driven timing also need review. Remains a draft.
Mobile review: the swing athlete is too small within the landscape canvas; a consistent tighter framing across all poses is required before release.

frames.caption: HINGE BACK 1/6
frames.cue: Hinge back; guide the bell between legs.

frames.caption: DRIVE YOUR HIPS 2/6
frames.cue: Drive through your feet and extend hips.

frames.caption: LET THE BELL FLOAT 3/6
frames.cue: Stand tall; let the bell reach chest height.

frames.caption: STAY TALL 4/6
frames.cue: Brace your abs without leaning back.

frames.caption: GUIDE THE DESCENT 5/6
frames.cue: Let the bell fall; keep arms relaxed.

frames.caption: HINGE AGAIN 6/6
frames.cue: Hinge back as the bell passes your legs.
